Reading all files under [Source/Hearth.Core](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core), [Source/Hearth/Contracts](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts), and [Source/Silverline/Contracts](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Silverline/Contracts) to inspect the foundation, contracts, lifecycle, serialization, and testing infrastructure. ### (1) Bugs, Crashes, Save/Load & Lifecycle Failures 1. **`Venues.All` returns dead objects from the previous save after loading an earlier save or starting a new game** - **Where:** [Venues.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/Venues.cs#L124-L145) (`Venues.cache`, `Venues.builtTick`, `Venues.All(Map)`) - **Why it matters:** `cache` and `builtTick` are static dictionaries keyed by `map.uniqueID` (always `0` for the first map) and are never cleared on load/new game. Line 133 checks `now - b < 250`. If a player plays to tick `50,000` (`b = 50000`) and then loads a save or starts a new game at tick `1,000` (`now = 1000`), `now - b` is `-49000 < 250`, returning destroyed/unloaded `Thing`, `CompVenueSign`, and `Room` instances from the old save for 49,250 ticks. - **Exact fix:** Add `Venues.Clear()` and call it from `HearthGame.StartedNewGame()` and `HearthGame.LoadedGame()`. Change line 133 to `now >= b && now - b < 250`, and verify `list.All(v => v.Sign != null && v.Sign.Spawned && v.Sign.Map == map)`. 2. **Adding the mod to an existing save never clones `HearthMod.Template.Profile`** - **Where:** [HearthGame.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthGame.cs#L17-L86) (`HearthGame.Profile`, `HearthGame.ExposeData`, `HearthGame.LoadedGame`) - **Why it matters:** `Profile` has field initializer `= new HearthProfile()`. When loading an existing save that did not have the mod, `Scribe_Collections.Look` loads saved `GameComponent`s first, and `Game.FillComponents()` instantiates missing `GameComponent`s via `new HearthGame(game)` **after** `LoadingVars`. `HearthGame.ExposeData()` is never called when the component is absent from the save XML. Thus `Profile` is never `null`, line 82 never runs, and the save gets an unconfigured default `HearthProfile` instead of `HearthMod.Template.Profile.CloneForNewGame()`. - **Exact fix:** Add `bool exposed;` to `HearthGame`, set `exposed = true;` inside `ExposeData()`, and in `LoadedGame()` check: ```csharp if (!exposed) { Profile = HearthMod.Template.Profile.CloneForNewGame(); Profile.FirstStartCardDone = false; HLog.Info("Core", "Mod added to an existing save: new profile from template"); } ``` 3. **`SettingRow.Draw` silently overwrites and locks tier-linked settings on the first GUI frame** - **Where:** [SimpleSettingsWindow.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/SimpleSettingsWindow.cs#L98-L120) (`SettingRow.Draw`), [HSettings.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HSettings.cs#L134-L139) (`HSettings.Get(HSetting)`) - **Why it matters:** - `HSettings.Get(HSetting s)` (line 138) returns `s.DefaultFor(Tier)` **without** calling `s.Clamp(...)`. For `Int`/`Money` settings with `TierAnchors` at non-integer tiers (or fractional anchor interpolation), `Get(s)` returns an unrounded float (e.g. `12.5f`) and does not enforce `EffectiveHardMax`. - In `SettingRow.Draw` (line 100), `Widgets.HorizontalSlider` rounds its return value to `roundTo` (`1f` or `s.Step`) on **every** `OnGUI` frame even without user input. Comparing `Math.Abs(nv - clampedVal) > 1e-6f` triggers on frame 1 and calls `HSettings.Set(s, nv)`, marking the setting as user-overridden (`Store.Has(s.Key) == true`) and detaching it from the difficulty slider just by scrolling past it. - In free-text mode (lines 107–113), `float.TryParse` and `HSettings.Set(s, c)` run on every frame even when `nb == buf`, immediately locking any non-overridden setting the moment `Free` is checked. - **Exact fix:** - In `HSettings.Get(HSetting s)`, return `s.Clamp(s.DefaultFor(Tier))`. - In `SettingRow.Draw`, round the input value passed to `Widgets.HorizontalSlider` by the same `roundTo` step before comparing `Math.Abs(nv - roundedInput) > 1e-6f`. - In the `free` branch, only parse and call `HSettings.Set(s, c)` when `nb != buf`. Clear `buffers` whenever `prof.Tier` changes. 4. **`GuestApi.fallbackInfo` leaks `Pawn`/`Map`/`Game` across reloads and collides on `thingIDNumber`** - **Where:** [GuestApi.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/GuestApi.cs#L51-L76) (`GuestApi.fallbackInfo`, `GuestApi.Info(Pawn)`) - **Why it matters:** `fallbackInfo` is a static `Dictionary` keyed by `p.thingIDNumber` that is never cleared on load/new game or pawn despawn. Each `GuestInfo` holds a strong reference to `Pawn` (and transitively `Map` and `Game`), leaking entire game instances across reloads. In a new or reloaded save, a different pawn with the same `thingIDNumber` receives the previous save's `GuestInfo` (`gi.Pawn != p`, depleted `Budget`, wrong `ArrivedTick`). - **Exact fix:** Check `if (!fallbackInfo.TryGetValue(p.thingIDNumber, out var gi) || gi.Pawn != p)` in `GuestApi.Info`, clear `fallbackInfo` on `StartedNewGame`/`LoadedGame`, and periodically prune entries where `gi.Pawn == null || !gi.Pawn.Spawned || gi.Pawn.Dead`. 5. **`JRandState` streams accessed before `StartedNewGame`/`LoadedGame` cache `Seed = 0` for the entire session** - **Where:** [HearthGame.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthGame.cs#L24-L45) and [HearthGame.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthGame.cs#L96-L108) (`JRandState.Init`, `JRandState.Stream`) - **Why it matters:** `new HearthGame(game)` sets `Instance = this` with `Rand.Seed == 0`. In RimWorld, map generation, `ThingComp.PostSpawnSetup`, and `GameComponent.FinalizeInit()` all execute **before** `StartedNewGame()` and `LoadedGame()`. Any call to `JRand.Stream` or `JRand.Sealed` during those phases caches an `RngStream` with `Seed = 0` in `JRandState.live`. When `Rand.Init(...)` later sets `Seed`, it does not clear `live`, so those streams remain seeded with `0`. - **Exact fix:** In `JRandState.Init(int seed)`, clear `live` (saving counters first if any), and in `JRandState.Stream`, lazily initialize `if (Seed == 0) Init(GenText.StableStringHash(Find.World?.info?.seedString ?? "hh"));`. 6. **`Tills.FlushAll` assigns `stackCount > stackLimit` to one `Thing` and duplicates silver on partial placement failure** - **Where:** [Payments.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Contracts/Payments.cs#L123-L131) (`Tills.FlushAll`) - **Why it matters:** Line 125 sets `silver.stackCount = coins` on a single `Thing` even when `coins > ThingDefOf.Silver.stackLimit` (500). `GenPlace.TryPlaceThing` splits off stacks in a loop; if the first N stacks are placed and the last stack fails (e.g. full room), `TryPlaceThing` returns `false`, skipping `l.Post(acc, "world", ...)` while leaving the already-placed stacks on the map, duplicating silver on the next flush. - **Exact fix:** Loop while `coins > 0` in chunks of `int stack = Math.Min(coins, ThingDefOf.Silver.stackLimit)`, and call `l.Post(acc, "world", Money.FromSilver(stack), "Till emptied as silver")` for each placed stack. 7. **`RngStream.Range(int min, int maxExclusive)` signed 32-bit overflow when `maxExclusive - min > int.MaxValue`** - **Where:** [JRandCore.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Pure/JRandCore.cs#L68-L73) (`RngStream.Range(int, int)`) - **Why it matters:** `maxExclusive - min` is computed as a signed `int` before casting to `ulong`. When `min < 0` and the span exceeds `int.MaxValue`, the subtraction overflows to a negative `int`, sign-extending to `> 2^63` in `ulong` and overflowing back to `(int)`. - **Exact fix:** Replace line 71 with `ulong span = (ulong)((long)maxExclusive - min);`. 8. **`Money.ToString()` vs `Money.Parse()` incompatibility breaks Scribe if `Money` is ever used with `Scribe_Values`** - **Where:** [Money.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Pure/Money.cs#L51-L59) (`Money.ToString`, `Money.Parse`), [Ledger.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/Ledger.cs#L28) (`Ledger.Entry.ExposeData`) - **Why it matters:** `Money.ToString()` formats as `"#,##0.00"` (losing 3 decimal places and inserting commas), while `Money.Parse` calls `long.Parse(s, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)` expecting raw integer `Micro`. Any module author using `Scribe_Values` or `ParseHelper` on `Money` will hit `FormatException`. - **Exact fix:** Add a helper `ScribeMoney.Look(ref Money value, string label, Money defaultValue = default)` that scribes `long micro = value.Micro` via `Scribe_Values.Look(ref micro, label, defaultValue.Micro)`, and use it in `Ledger.Entry.ExposeData()`. 9. **Static events `Ledger.Changed` and `Payments.Paid` leak subscribers across saves and can throw mid-transaction** - **Where:** [Ledger.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/Ledger.cs#L61-L66), [Payments.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Contracts/Payments.cs#L59-L65) - **Why it matters:** Both events are `static` and never cleared on load/new game, leaking any `GameComponent`/`MapComponent`/UI subscribers from previous saves and invoking dead callbacks. Also, `Changed?.Invoke(...)` in `Ledger.Post` is not wrapped in `try/catch`; a throwing subscriber aborts the caller **after** `balances`, `journal`, and `daily` have already been mutated. - **Exact fix:** Wrap each subscriber invocation in `try/catch` (logging via `HLog.Error`), or make `Changed` an instance event on `Ledger`. --- ### (2) RimWorld API Misuse & Pitfalls 1. **Harmony patches are applied in the `Mod` constructor instead of `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`** - **Where:** [HearthMod.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthMod.cs#L90-L117) (`HearthMod` ctor, `ApplyPatches`) - **Why it matters:** `Mod` constructors execute **before** XML `Def`s are loaded, before `[DefOf]` fields are populated, and before other mods finish loading. Any `[HarmonyPatch]` class whose `Prepare()`, `TargetMethod()`, or static initializer touches `DefOf` or `DefDatabase` will see `null`/empty databases and fail. - **Exact fix:** Move `Harmony = new Harmony(HarmonyId); ApplyPatches(asms);` from `HearthMod` constructor into `HearthStartup` (`[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`) before calling `m.OnDefsLoaded()`. 2. **`GuestApi.IsVanillaVisitor` hijacks quest Bestowers, Imperial guards, military aid, beggars, and travelers, and drops downed visitors** - **Where:** [GuestApi.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/GuestApi.cs#L60-L62) (`GuestApi.IsVanillaVisitor`) - **Why it matters:** - `p.GetLord() != null` is true for almost every friendly NPC group on a player home map: Royal Bestowing Ceremony pawns (`LordJob_BestowingCeremony`), military aid (`LordJob_AssistColony`), beggars (`LordJob_BegForItems`), and passing travelers (`LordJob_TravelAndExit`). When `Inn` is off, `GuestActivities.TryPick` will pull Bestowers or military aid soldiers out of their duties to gamble or shop. - `!p.Downed` makes `IsGuest(p)` and `Info(p)` return `false`/`null` the instant a guest is downed, breaking medical rescue, insurance, and caretaker checks for downed guests. - **Exact fix:** Check `var lj = p.GetLord()?.LordJob; bool isVisitorLord = lj is LordJob_VisitColony || lj is LordJob_TradeWithColony;` in `IsVanillaVisitor`, and in `Info(p)` still return existing `fallbackInfo` for downed pawns that were already registered as visitors. 3. **Midnight till flush mixes UTC tick day (`t / 60000`) with local timezone hour (`GenLocalDate.HourOfDay(home)`) and does not save `lastTillDay`** - **Where:** [HearthGame.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthGame.cs#L22) and [HearthGame.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthGame.cs#L67-L72) - **Why it matters:** - `lastTillDay` is not saved in `ExposeData()`. Saving and reloading during local hour 0 (`00:00–00:59`) resets `lastTillDay = -1` and flushes tills a second time. - `t / 60000` is the raw game-tick day, whereas `GenLocalDate.HourOfDay(home) == 0` depends on map longitude and `gameStartAbsTick`. If `t / 60000` rolls over during local hour 0, or if the player has multiple home maps at different longitudes, flushes can double-fire or skip. - **Exact fix:** Persist `lastTillDay` in `HearthGame.ExposeData()` via `Scribe_Values.Look(ref lastTillDay, "lastTillDay", -1)` and compute the local day via `GenDate.DaysPassedAt(GenLocalDate.TickAbs(home))` (or track per-map last flush day). 4. **`SettingRow.Draw` reads/writes `freeText` in the per-save `Store` even for `s.Global == true` settings** - **Where:** [SimpleSettingsWindow.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/SimpleSettingsWindow.cs#L95) (`SettingRow.Draw`) - **Why it matters:** `HSettings.Store(s)` uses `HearthMod.Template.Store` when `s.Global` is true, but line 95 of `SimpleSettingsWindow.cs` uses `HearthProfile.Current?.Store ?? HearthMod.Template.Store`, reading/writing `freeText` in the wrong store for global settings while a game is loaded. - **Exact fix:** Make `HSettings.Store(HSetting s)` `internal` and call `HSettings.Store(s)` on line 95. 5. **`About.xml` lists `Orion.Hospitality` in both `` and ``, and `LoadFolders.xml` includes `
  • /
    • `** - **Where:** [About.xml](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/About/About.xml#L38-L48), [LoadFolders.xml](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/LoadFolders.xml#L3-L5) - **Why it matters:** Listing an incompatible mod in `` is contradictory metadata. In `LoadFolders.xml`, `
  • /
    • ` makes RimWorld scan the mod root directory for `Defs/`, `Assemblies/`, etc. in addition to `Common` and `1.7`. - **Exact fix:** Remove `
  • Orion.Hospitality
    • ` from `` in `About.xml` and remove `
  • /
    • ` from `LoadFolders.xml`. 6. **`Common/Defs/Core/Core_WorkAndResearch.xml` puts hospitality work types and research tab in `Core`** - **Where:** [Core_WorkAndResearch.xml](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Common/Defs/Core/Core_WorkAndResearch.xml#L4-L32) - **Why it matters:** When `Silverline` ships standalone (only `Core` + `Bank`), loading `Common/Defs/Core` injects `HH_Hosting` ("Host"), `HH_Serving` ("Serve"), and `HH_Hospitality` into the game even though no guest or venue modules exist. - **Exact fix:** Move `HH_Hosting`, `HH_Serving`, and `HH_Hospitality` out of `Common/Defs/Core` into a guest-only Def folder (and `HH_Banking` into `Common/Defs/Bank`). --- ### (3) Performance Risks 1. **`HLog.Debug` performs synchronous disk I/O (`new FileInfo` + `File.AppendAllText`) and evicts `HLog.Recent` even when `HLog.Verbose == false`** - **Where:** [HLog.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HLog.cs#L56-L95) (`HLog.Write`, `HLog.AppendFile`) - **Why it matters:** Line 69 (`if (level == LogLevel.Debug && !Verbose) return;`) runs **after** string formatting, `Recent.AddLast(line)`, and `AppendFile(line)`. Every `HLog.Debug` call during gameplay opens, writes, and closes `HearthHarbor.log` on the main thread and pushes debug lines into the 300-line `Recent` diagnosis buffer (evicting real warnings and errors) even when `Verbose` is off. - **Exact fix:** Move `if (level == LogLevel.Debug && !Verbose) return;` to the first line of `HLog.Write`, and keep a persistent `StreamWriter` open instead of calling `new FileInfo` + `File.AppendAllText` on every log entry. 2. **`Venues.All(Map)` scans every artificial building on the map with `TryGetComp()` every 250 ticks** - **Where:** [Venues.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/Venues.cs#L135-L142) (`Venues.All`) - **Why it matters:** `ThingRequestGroup.BuildingArtificial` contains every wall, door, conduit, and furniture piece on the map (often 10,000+ buildings). Scanning all of them with `TryGetComp()` every 250 ticks (or whenever `MarkDirty` is called) causes unnecessary main-thread spikes. - **Exact fix:** Track spawned signs in `static readonly Dictionary> signsByMap`, adding in `CompVenueSign.PostSpawnSetup` and removing in `CompVenueSign.PostDeSpawn`. `Venues.All(map)` then iterates only actual signs. 3. **`JRand.Stream` allocates a new `RngStream` and runs two setting lookups on every call when `core.sealedFate` is false (the default)** - **Where:** [HearthGame.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/HearthGame.cs#L124-L143) (`JRand.Stream`, `JRand.VanillaStream`), [JRandCore.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Pure/JRandCore.cs#L102-L117) (`RngStream.ChaChaLite`) - **Why it matters:** `core.sealedFate` defaults to `false`. Every call to `JRand.Stream(name)` performs two dictionary lookups (`HSettings.GetBool("core.sealedFate")` and `HSettings.GetInt("core.rngAlgorithm")`) and allocates `new RngStream(...)`. Also, `ChaChaLite` allocates two `uint[16]` arrays on the heap on every `NextULong()` call. - **Exact fix:** Reuse a static `RngStream` instance in `JRand` (reseeding it in place) or cache the `HSetting` references directly (`static readonly HSetting SealedFateSetting, AlgoSetting`), and use `stackalloc uint[16]` (or local `uint` variables) in `ChaChaLite`. 4. **`GuestActivities.TryPick` allocates closures, concatenated site strings, and a `List` on every think-tree evaluation** - **Where:** [GuestApi.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/GuestApi.cs#L140-L159) (`GuestActivities.TryPick`) - **Why it matters:** Called frequently by guest think nodes. Allocates `new List<(IGuestActivity, float)>()`, concatenates `"Activity.Desire." + a.Id` and `"Activity.Job." + pick.a.Id`, allocates lambda closures for `Guard.Run`, and uses LINQ `options.Sum(o => o.w)`. - **Exact fix:** Reuse a static `List<(IGuestActivity a, float w)>` buffer, accumulate `float sum` in a loop without LINQ, and pre-cache site names on registration. 5. **`SimpleSettingsWindow.Draw` runs LINQ `.Where().OrderBy().ThenBy()` and 3 `.ToLowerInvariant()` allocations per setting on every `OnGUI` event** - **Where:** [SimpleSettingsWindow.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/SimpleSettingsWindow.cs#L46-L64) (`SimpleSettingsWindow.Draw`, `Match`) - **Why it matters:** `OnGUI` runs multiple times per rendered frame. Re-sorting all settings and allocating lowercase strings on every GUI event causes constant GC allocations while settings are open. - **Exact fix:** Cache the filtered/sorted `List` and rebuild it only when `search`, `tpl.ShowNerd`, or the active game changes; use `string.IndexOf(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0`. --- ### (4) Design Problems in Contracts 1. **`Guard` tracks `consecutive` failures per `ModuleId` instead of per `(ModuleId, site)` and does not short-circuit when paused** - **Where:** [Guard.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/Guard.cs#L19-L68) (`Guard.consecutive`, `Guard.Run`, `Guard.Ok`, `Guard.Fail`) - **Why it matters:** - `Ok(ModuleId m)` resets `consecutive[m] = 0` for the entire module. If one site in a module throws 100% of the time (e.g. one activity's `Desire` or one patch), and any other `Guard.Run` in the same module succeeds (e.g. a second activity in the same `GuestActivities.TryPick` loop), `consecutive[m]` is reset to `0` every tick and **never** reaches `MaxConsecutive = 3`. - `Guard.Run` does not check `if (IsPaused(m)) return;`. Call sites that invoke `Guard.Run(ModuleId.Bank, ...)` without first checking `Modules.On(ModuleId.Bank)` (e.g. `Tills.FlushAll` line 122 and `BankTabs.VisibleTabs` line 46) continue executing paused or disabled modules. - `paused`, `consecutive`, and `PauseReasons` are static and never cleared on game load/new game, and `SimpleSettingsWindow` has no UI to view `PauseReasons` or call `Guard.Resume(m)` (despite the pause letter instructing the player to open Mod Settings to restart it). - **Exact fix:** Key `consecutive` by `string site` (or `(ModuleId, string)`), check `if (IsPaused(m)) return;` (and `return fallback;`) at the top of `Guard.Run`, clear `paused`/`consecutive` on `Resume` or new session as intended, and draw a "Paused modules / Resume" banner at the top of `SimpleSettingsWindow.Draw`. 2. **`Ledger` daily reporting (`DayTotal` / `DayTotalPrefix`) and income/expense categories are broken by double-entry till flushing** - **Where:** [Ledger.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Foundation/Ledger.cs#L11-L70) (`Ledger.Post`, `Ledger.DayTotal`, `Ledger.DayTotalPrefix`), [Payments.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Contracts/Payments.cs#L100-L128), [GuestApi.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/GuestApi.cs#L104-L116) - **Why it matters:** - `Ledger.cs` line 14 documents `"colony:income:" / "colony:expense:"` as bookkeeping categories for reports. However, `Payments.TryCharge`, `InventorySilverProvider.TryPay`, and `GuestApi.ChargeGuest` always book `from: "world"` (or guest account) `to: "colony:till:"`. `GuestApi.ChargeGuest` never passes `category` to `Payments.TryCharge` or `Ledger.Post`. Nothing ever posts to `"colony:income:"`. - `Ledger.Post` updates `daily[day][to] += amount` and `daily[day][from] -= amount`. When guests pay into `"colony:till:0"` during the day and `Tills.FlushAll()` posts `from: "colony:till:0", to: "world"` at midnight, `daily[day]["colony:till:0"]` is reduced back to **zero**. Consequently, `DayTotal(day, Payments.ColonyTill(map))` is zeroed every night and `DayTotalPrefix(day, "colony:income:")` is always `0`. - **Exact fix:** Book external income from `"colony:income:" + category` (allowing negative balances on `"colony:income:*"` accounts, which represents cumulative credit revenue while `"world"` is only used when physical silver is spawned/destroyed, or add an explicit `string category = null` parameter to `Ledger.Post` and `Payments.TryCharge` that records category totals in `daily[day]["colony:income:" + category]` independently of till flushes). 3. **`Payments` and `GuestApi` lack any payout/refund contract (`TryPayout` / `CreditGuest`), lack module-gating on `IPaymentProvider`, and mismatch `Available` vs `TryCharge`** - **Where:** [Payments.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth.Core/Contracts/Payments.cs#L13-L103) (`IPaymentProvider`, `Payments`, `InventorySilverProvider`), [GuestApi.cs](file:///Users/julius/Documents/Coding/22_RimWorld/HearthHarbor/Source/Hearth/Contracts/GuestApi.cs#L35-L116) (`IGuestApiImpl`, `GuestApi`) - **Why it matters:** - `AGENTS.md` Rule 5 forbids modules from spawning or destroying silver directly, yet `Payments` and `GuestApi` only support charging a pawn (`TryCharge` / `ChargeGuest`). Modules have no contract method to pay casino winnings, buy items at a fence, pay insurance claims, or refund guests in `PrepareRemoval`. - `IPaymentProvider` has no `ModuleId Module { get; }` property. Providers registered by `Bank` or `Casino` remain active in `Payments.providers` even when their module is disabled, and `Payments` wraps them in `Guard.Run(ModuleId.Core, ...)` instead of `p.Module`. - `Payments.Available(payer)` sums across all providers, whereas `Payments.TryCharge` requires a single provider to cover the entire `amount` (`p.Available(payer) >= amount`).
